description: Permissions for the OIS main window and the windows it opens: Tauri's core defaults, signed auto-update (#347), native notifications (#348), creating / placing / pinning pop-out panels (#349) and whole-route windows (#350), the menu-bar tray (#351), OS-level global shortcuts (#352), and — since the main window has no native title bar — our own minimize / maximize / close and the top bar's drag region (#402; `is-maximized` is already in `core:window:default` and is listed only to keep the set self-describing, and `close` came with #349/#350). A notification click raises the window from Rust (src/notify.rs), so the window controls here are for raising an already-open pop-out or route window, not for notification clicks. Tray and menu themselves are already covered by core:default. Pop-out panels get their own, narrower set — see popout.json.
